lay.help: Arranges all your widgets at once. Your notes and photos stay in the widget menu, so switching never loses them. You can always undo.
lay.name: Name (empty = date)
lib.erase_confirm: Delete this for good? This can't be undone.
lib.empty: Nothing here yet. Widgets you add show up here.
lib.changed: Changed elsewhere. The list is updated; try again.
lib.no_widget: Add a {type} widget to open this.
lib.history_none: No saved versions yet. Turn on memo history in Settings > Widgets.
gal.checklist.1: Today, This week and This month each keep their own list.
gal.checklist.2: Right-click to hide or clear finished items.
gal.calendar.1: Type ‘14:00 Meeting #work’ to add a time and a tag in one go.
gal.calendar.2: The gear on an entry sets its time, repeat, link and reminder.
gal.calendar.3: Right-click to switch between Big squares view and Small calendar view.
gal.dday.1: Countdown counts the days until a date. Anniversary counts the days since.
gal.memo.2: Right-click to change the note colour.
gal.diary.1: One page a day, saved as you type.
gal.diary.2: Use the arrows to move between days, or pick a date.
gal.clock.1: Right-click to choose a time zone or show seconds.
gal.timer.1: Right-click to switch between timer, stopwatch and pomodoro.
gal.timer.2: Click the digits to type a time, or scroll over them to change it by a minute.
gal.timer.3: The pomodoro’s ‘N today’ button opens Pomodoro settings.
gal.image.1: Drop images onto it or click it to add them.
gal.image.2: Right-click to switch between slideshow and grid.
gal.image.3: In the grid, drag a tile to reorder it. Double-click one to name it.
gal.showcase.1: Click the name to set the name and birthday.
gal.showcase.2: Drop photos onto the card to add them.
gal.nowplaying.1: Shows and controls what Windows is playing.
gal.nowplaying.2: My files plays audio files from your PC.
